section: AVI-SPL support and maintenance levels: Enhanced, Elite and Enterprise Maintenance with 24/7 help desk
body:
AVI-SPL's support and maintenance page sets out the support options for AV/UC technology after it is installed, including a 24/7 help desk and field dispatch. This brief lists each level exactly as the page describes it.

**General model**
- AVI-SPL offers both on-site resources and remote technical support.
- Service level agreements come in several tiers, with add-on "plus" options to tailor them.
- Support options include manufacturer warranty support, an unlimited 24/7 help desk available every day, and local repair and service dispatch.
- AVI-SPL describes a global network with technicians distributed around the world who understand local intricacies and methods.

**Enhanced support** (extra remote responsiveness)
- Unlimited remote help desk support, available globally 24/7 every day
- Facilitation of manufacturer warranty repair or replacement programs
- Remote software and firmware updates for covered assets

**Elite support** (extra onsite responsiveness)
- Unlimited onsite support M-F, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. local time
- 24/7 unlimited global remote help desk support
- Facilitation of manufacturer warranty repair or replacement programs
- Remote software and firmware updates for covered assets

**Enterprise Maintenance**
A subscription service giving 24/7 technical support for audio-visual and unified collaboration spaces, intended to simplify management and reduce cost of ownership. It includes:
- 24/7 support from certified technicians
- Support for over 700 manufacturer technologies
- A fixed price subscription regardless of the technology deployed
- Automatic support when in-room technology changes
- Service portability to new rooms or room locations
- Flexible subscription options for remote or on-site support
- Room subscriptions of 25, 100, and 250 rooms
- 1 and 3-year term options

**Customer comment on the page**
A verified user, a manager in information technology at a construction company with 10,001+ employees, calls AVI-SPL their preferred AV vendor and says AVI-SPL helped convert all conference rooms larger than 10 people to Teams, which are now the most used conference rooms on campus.

**When to use this**
Use it when a customer asks what support tiers exist, what the difference is between remote and onsite coverage, onsite support hours, or how the room-based subscription works.

**Not stated in this source**: prices, response or resolution times, or what the "plus" add-ons contain.
